name: Docker container troubleshooting
description: Diagnosing Docker containers that fail to start, stop unexpectedly, crash, restart repeatedly, or have configuration, volume, network, image, environment variable, or resource problems.

name: Linux service troubleshooting
description: Diagnosing Linux systemd services that fail to start, stop unexpectedly, report errors, do not listen on the expected port, or have configuration, dependency, and resource problems.

name: GitHub Actions troubleshooting
description: Diagnosing GitHub Actions workflow, job, build, test, permission, secret, Docker build, artifact, and deployment failures.

name: Linux resource troubleshooting
description: Diagnosing Linux systems with high CPU, memory pressure, swap usage, full disks, inode exhaustion, excessive logs, I/O problems, or slow performance.

name: Network troubleshooting
description: Diagnosing DNS failures, connection refused errors, timeouts, routing, listening ports, firewalls, TLS issues, HTTP errors, Docker networking, and cloud network access.
